name: Ojanen
description: The first tiger warrior, who led his tribe, realized Terrent Amese was no god, and rebelled against him.

description_citations.text: "Terrent Amese". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ojanen leads the tribe in building the Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale as a place of worship and watch-post.
timeline.quote: Terrent Amese named the first tiger warrior Ojanen

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ojanen realizes his people are slave labor and Terrent Amese no god, and rallies the tribe to seek independence.
timeline.quote: He rallied his tribe behind him and tried to obtain their independence from their creator.

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terrent Amese curses the Ojanen line, creates Ur-Drago to exterminate the tribe, and disappears; Ojanen fights the beast while the tribe flees Scarwood.
timeline.quote: Terrent Amese cursed the Ojanen line and created the monster Ur-Drago to exterminate the tribe before disappearing, never to be seen again.

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: the hidden city where Terrent Amese created the first Ojanen
